papers_identified.title: From Text to Alpha: Can LLMs Track Evolving Signals in Corporate Disclosures?
papers_identified.venue: arXiv Oct 2025 (institutional authors: MIT, BlackRock, J.P. Morgan, Fidelity, Blackstone, State Street, QRT)
papers_identified.topic: LLM on earnings call transcripts — 'metric shifting' as alpha signal
papers_identified.result_preview: 5-factor alpha -0.52%/month (Q5-Q1), significant at 5%. LLM extracts which metrics management STOPS emphasizing quarter-over-quarter as a bearish signal.

papers_identified.title: Debiasing LLMs by Fine-tuning
papers_identified.topic: LLM extrapolation bias in stock return prediction; LoRA fine-tuning corrects it
papers_identified.result_preview: LLMs systematically over-extrapolate recent returns in cross-sectional stock prediction. LoRA on rational benchmarks corrects bias out-of-sample.

papers_identified.title: Measuring Strategy-Decay Risk: Minimum Regime Performance and the Durability of Systematic Investing
papers_identified.topic: New diagnostic: Minimum Regime Performance (MRP) — lowest risk-adjusted return across historical regimes
papers_identified.result_preview: High long-term Sharpe != high MRP. Strategies that look efficient may be fragile in worst regimes. Applicable to rounds 1-30 backtest library.

papers_identified.title: Explainable Regime Aware Investing
papers_identified.topic: Wasserstein Hidden Markov Model for regime detection; causal, explainable, dynamically defensive
papers_identified.result_preview: Sharpe 2.18 vs SPX 1.18; max drawdown -5.43% vs -14.62%. Outperformed during 2025 Liberation Day selloff. Could replace VIX/SMA RegimeGuard in R28.

papers_identified.title: Leveraging LLMs for Top-Down Sector Allocation in Automated Trading
papers_identified.topic: LLM reads macro data to allocate across S&P sectors
papers_identified.result_preview: Sharpe 2.51 vs -0.61 baseline. LLM macro-to-sector allocation works when given structured macro/sentiment data.

papers_identified.title: The Co-Pricing Factor Zoo
papers_identified.topic: 18 quadrillion bond+equity pricing models; Bayesian factor averaging
papers_identified.result_preview: Only handful of behavioral/nontradable factors are robust. BMA across many factors achieves OOS Sharpe 1.5-1.8. Not directly actionable for current stack.

papers_identified.title: Skewness Dispersion and Stock Market Returns
papers_identified.topic: Cross-sectional firm skewness dispersion predicts aggregate market returns (negatively)
papers_identified.result_preview: High dispersion in firm-level realized skewness predicts lower future market returns. Concentrates around monetary policy announcements. Potential regime signal.

papers_identified.title: Deep Learning for Financial Time Series: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Risk-Adjusted Performance
papers_identified.topic: DL benchmark on futures (2010-2025). VSN+LSTM wins.
papers_identified.result_preview: Not applicable to equity event-driven (PEAD/dividend) strategies. Confirms hybrid CNN-recurrent beats pure transformer on futures.
